items.title: KiYoung Choi named Representative Director of Korea
items.summary: KiYoung Choi is joining Anthropic as Representative Director of Korea, ahead of the opening of our Seoul office.
items.summaryZh: KiYoung Choi 被任命为韩国代表董事。# Anthropic 在首尔办事处开设之前任命 KiYoung Choi 为韩国代表董事 韩国是 Claude.ai 全球最活跃的市场之一。根据我们最新的经济指数，韩国人对克劳德的使用率是其人口规模预期的 3.5 倍以上，其中使用率严重偏向于技术和创意工作。

items.title: Some ideas for what comes next, May 2026
items.summary: As the years of AI progress go by, it’s been accompanied by a slowly rising tide of consequence. Models are getting more capable, how we work is changing quickly, economics of AI are becoming real, just as real-world risks come to the forefront. 2026 is the first year where I don’t think there’ll be any breaks from this. items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了2026年AI进展面临的后果与复杂性，重点分析了开源模型在智能体（Agent）领域的滞后现象。作者指出，自闭源模型在2025年底实现重大突破以来，开源社区尚未出现同等能力的高效代理产品，开源与闭源之间的差距依然存在。

items.title: MiniCPM5-1B
items.summary: We are releasing MiniCPM5-1B , the first model in the MiniCPM5 series. It is a dense 1B Transformer built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 1B-class open-source SOTA. 🏆 1B-class open-source SOTA : MiniCPM5-1B reaches an average score of 42.57 across reasoning, knowledge, code, instruction-following, math, logic and agentic benchmarks, above the highest average score of 35.6
items.summaryZh: 面壁智能发布MiniCPM5-1B，这是MiniCPM5系列的首款密集型1B Transformer模型，专为端侧本地部署打造。其在推理、代码、数学及智能体基准测试中创下1B量级开源SOTA，支持内置的思考模式切换，并配套提供丰富的智能体技能与部署指南。
